about: CONCEPT illustrations, not photos of what is installed: the owner's AI-generated concept images (2026-10-07) of the proposed Futures Friends Learning Zones kit (zone mats, posters, plush) in classrooms laid out like the real Futures Learning Center rooms in img/center/. They replace the earlier Pillow composites, which the owner rejected. No people. Always shown with the label below and the plain real photo one tap away (brand-art.js photo(): Real room / With the kit). Served at 400/800/1200 px as WebP + JPEG, metadata stripped. Some posters read 'Move. Play. Grow.' as poster art.
label: Concept: the Futures Friends Learning Zones kit in our classroom
credit: Photo: Futures Learning Center, Independence, Missouri; kit shown as an AI-generated concept illustration
